info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Realestate Listings Details-v2-spec
info.description: The Real Estate Listings Details API allows users to retrieve comprehensive details about available real estate listings. This endpoint serves real estate agents, property investors, and prospective buyers looking for in-depth information on properties. Users can access critical data such as property specifications, pricing, and location details, facilitating informed decision-making. The API is essential for applications that aggregate or display real estate information, enhancing the user experience in real estate platforms.

get.summary: Retrieve detailed information about a specific listing.
get.description: This endpoint fetches comprehensive details about a particular listing, including its specifications, pricing, availability, and related information to help users evaluate the offering effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve detailed information about listings. The payload must be formatted in JSON and should comply with the specified schema to ensure the correct data structure and required fields are provided.
